name: Python Peaks
description: Climb the snowy peaks with Pyra the owl-wizard and learn to speak Python — the language that powers apps, games, and robots.

name: Game Forge
description: Step into Gigabyte the inventor's workshop and discover how games are built, frame by frame.

name: Pixel Studio
description: Hue the artist will teach you color, shape, and layout — the building blocks of great design.

name: Data Delta
description: Explore the river of numbers with Nova the explorer-analyst and learn to find the stories hidden in data.

name: Mind Machine
description: Axiom the calm AI sage will show you how machines learn to recognize patterns, just like you do.
